description: This PHP source file defines the API endpoints and logic for handling 'My Leave Requests' within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, and updating individual leave requests, with appropriate validation, authorization, and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: MyLeaveRequestAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints and logic for managing 'My Leave Requests', including methods for retrieval, listing, creation, and updates within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLeaveApplicationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LeaveApplicationService, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave request by ID, returning detailed or basic info based on query parameter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all leave requests for the authenticated user, supporting filtering and returning detailed models.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles applying for a new leave request, returning the created leave request details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing leave request, such as approving, rejecting, or cancelling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'get all' leave requests API call.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new leave request.

methods.name: checkLeaveRequestAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to the specified leave request.
